description: This file implements orchestration logic for managing certification jobs, interacting with Airflow DAGs, handling retries, updating job statuses, and polling DAG run states asynchronously.

methods.name: _with_retries(coro_fn, attempts: int, backoff: float, base_delay: float = 0.5)
methods.description: Executes an asynchronous function with exponential backoff retries.

methods.name: Optional[str] _dag_id_for_type(cert_type: CertificationType)
methods.description: Retrieves the DAG ID associated with a certification type based on settings.

methods.name: None _update_job_status(session: AsyncSession, job: CertificationJob)
methods.description: Updates a CertificationJob's overall status based on individual result statuses.

methods.name: None _save_dag_run_info(session: AsyncSession, job: CertificationJob, cert_type: CertificationType, dag_run_id: str)
methods.description: Stores the DAG run ID and DAG ID into the job's result metrics for traceability.

methods.name: None _mark_running(session: AsyncSession, job: CertificationJob, cert_type: CertificationType)
methods.description: Marks a specific certification type result as running and updates the overall job status.

methods.name: None _mark_terminal(session: AsyncSession, job: CertificationJob, cert_type: CertificationType, success: bool, logs_url: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Marks a certification type result as passed or failed, optionally logs a URL, and updates job status.

methods.name: None _poll_one(session_factory, job_run_id: str, cert_type: CertificationType, dag_id: str, dag_run_id: str)
methods.description: Polls a specific DAG run until completion, updating the database with the final status.

methods.name: None orchestrate_job(session: AsyncSession, job: CertificationJob)
methods.description: Main public function that triggers Airflow DAGs for each certification type and manages polling tasks in background.
